NUTRITION
  ENERGY:
    description "Aim for maintenance calories plus 400-500 kcal/day to support breastfeeding. Adjust based on hunger, energy, and weight trends."
  PROTEIN:
    description "At least 1.2g protein per kg bodyweight daily. Prioritize lean meats, fish, eggs, dairy, legumes, tofu, and nuts."
  CARBOHYDRATES:
    description "Include whole grains, fruits, and starchy vegetables at each meal for energy and milk production."
  FATS:
    description "Include healthy fats daily: olive oil, avocado, nuts, seeds, and fatty fish (2x/week)."
  HYDRATION:
    description "Drink at least 3L water daily. Increase intake if thirsty or urine is dark."
  MICRONUTRIENTS:
    description "Continue prenatal multivitamin. Ensure adequate calcium (1000mg), iron, vitamin D, and omega-3s (DHA/EPA)."
  MEAL STRUCTURE:
    description "Aim for 3 main meals and 2-3 snacks per day. Include a protein source and fruit/vegetable at each meal/snack."
  FOODS TO LIMIT:
    description "Limit caffeine to <300mg/day. Avoid alcohol. Limit highly processed foods and added sugars."
  SPECIAL NOTES:
    description "Monitor baby's response to foods. If any concerns (colic, rash, etc.), consult a registered dietitian or physician."

NOTES
  - "No jumping or plyometric work until week 11, per OB guidance."
  - "Core work is reintroduced with dead_bug in week 7, progressing volume and intensity gradually. Plank is added in week 11."
  - "Monitor for symptoms (pain, heaviness, incontinence, doming, coning) and regress if needed."
  - "Continue to emphasize hydration, protein, and micronutrient intake to support breastfeeding and recovery."
